verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own case management documents prioritising and reviewing risk alerts, filtering cases by risk, stage, assignee or creation date, and recording case decisions. Transaction-monitoring cases and alerts also exist as an export type. Nothing in the pack shows analysts grouping multiple related subjects and transactions into a single investigation. missing for 10: documented grouping of multiple subjects/transactions into one investigation, linking related entities across cases, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.
